{{Top|leg}}
'''Muo Glandish''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] living around [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was notable for constructing the [[StarForge Station]], a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] deep in the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]] in [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]], that was intended to be his base of operations. He saved the cost by building the station on existing planetoid, and using mostly junked [[Starship/Legends|starships]] remained from the battles fought within the nebula. However, soon after its completion, Glandish was killed. The station administration fell first to his friends, and later to a council of tenants who voted on the administrator, who deals with the day-to-day operations of the station.
